acceptance_criteria: P0: .omp/RULES.md declares the effective approval, memory and auto-learn posture and no longer contradicts .omp/config.yml
P1: make test delegates to the full npm test suite so the enrolled gate cannot pass while the root gate fails
P2: local-multi-endpoint T2-T4 assert local-inference degradation independently of live config, and a dedicated test still couples the aggregate status to config
P3: the exposure selector cannot admit auto/* or unlisted *-free providers, proven by a fixture row that fails before the fix
P4: the wiki of record has resolvable git history, memory.record.versioned rejects a broken store, and bin/kad-memory status reports record-to-mirror drift
P5: every ACCEPTED G1 evidence_target resolves, the 054 receipt references resolve, and the Gaya dataset artifacts are committed
P6: README.md derives phase, remote state, test inventory and memory authority from live state; the CSA matches HEAD and a liveness assertion detects drift

P7: stale claim released, gamedev-router frontmatter fixed, dual lockfile roles documented, technopagan suite green, 34 unsurfaced canonical skills decided, amdy-platform and wiki/ retired, gitleaks allowlist added
no gate was weakened to obtain PASS and no unapproved spend was created
description: Remediate the findings of the independent 2026-09-11 workspace review: align declared invariants with effective configuration, make the enrolled gates bind, close the model-exposure bypass, repair and re-validate the memory record, restore evidence durability, regenerate the derived front door, and retire dead weight.

scope_amendment.reason: The independent review found writes in the reviewed range that the declared scope did not name. Each is recorded here rather than left as an undeclared write.

added_paths.package.json: P1 requires `make test` to delegate to the npm test suite; the script lives in package.json.
added_paths..gitignore: P7 hygiene: the skill shadow corpus and generated islands are declared ignored.
added_paths.docs/adr/: The spend and learning policy corrections are ADR-shaped decisions (0016-0019); the card's description asks for the policy, and this repository records policy as ADRs.
added_paths.docs/generated/: Regenerated by the projection compiler that P6 makes the front door depend on.
added_paths.site/: Publication output of the same projection run.
added_paths.evidence/PLATFORM-BASELINE-2026-08-25/: Platform baseline receipts regenerated by the hygiene pass (46c6f98).
added_paths.evidence/WP-KAD-002/: The control-plane causal journal is appended by running the gates; it is a machine side effect of the work, not an authored change.

scope_amendment.non_scope_note: The non_scope clause 'evidence/** history outside the two named targets' is narrowed by this amendment: the control-plane journal is machine-appended and cannot be excluded while the gates run.

deviations.delivered: amdy-platform retired. wiki/ retired by substitution on 2026-09-12 (operator decision 5B): the librarian corpus and the curated sources moved to .agents/knowledge/, the generated projections to docs/generated/, and the remaining legacy documents were verified present in the wiki of record before the tree was removed.
deviations.resolution: The librarian verify step inside `make verify` now reads .agents/knowledge/synthetic/ and passes (28 documents, 32 cards, 23 concepts, 0 errors); the curated allowlist sources and the publication/projection defaults point at the new paths; the retired tree's remaining documents were each confirmed present at their migration destination (vault/90_Derived/KnowledgePlane/migration-manifest.json records all 75 entries, every destination present in the record at .ai-memory/wiki/…).

acceptance.decided_by: operator instruction, 2026-09-12: 'Accept the three workpackages'; evidence target carries the independent review receipt and the implementer verification
acceptance.review_findings: answered in the commits that follow the review; see the review receipt and the repository history
accepted_deviations: P7 PARTIAL: wiki/ is not retired (it is a live librarian input). The criterion stands unmet until the operator rules.
acceptance.independence_limit: The reviewer is a separate agent role in a separate context, not a separate human. Independence is bounded to that; acceptance authority is the operator instruction recorded here.
